notes: θεὶς … γόνατα → *kneeled down* joined as one unit under rule 73, the source head on γόνατα because *kneeled* is what realizes that token; the intervening article contributes no part of the collapsed verb and stays its own unrepresented unit (rules 23 and 93).
*forth* goes to the expressed adverb ἔξω rather than to the preverb of ἐκβαλών, a source token standing to answer to it (rule 106).
Both articles before Πέτρος are unrepresented (rule 23); ἡ takes the bare pronoun *she* under rule 22.
